trips.note: Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays: Sault Ste. Marie 9.00 a.m. to Hawk Junction 3.35 p.m.; on to Hearst 9.00 p.m. Cafe service. To Hearst. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

Hawk Junction 3.50 p.m. to Hearst 9.00 p.m. (printed daily except Sunday; the through train from Sault Ste. Marie runs Mon. Wed. Fri.). Franz 4.55 p.m., connection with the CP. From Sault Ste. Marie. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

Hearst 7.30 a.m. to Hawk Junction 12.25 p.m. (printed daily except Sunday; on to Sault Ste. Marie Tue. Thu. Sat.). To Sault Ste. Marie. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.
Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays: Hawk Junction 1.00 p.m. to Sault Ste. Marie 7.25 p.m. Cafe service. From Hearst. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays: Hawk Junction 4.00 p.m. to Michipicoten 5.30 p.m., connection from No. 1 from Sault Ste. Marie. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays: Michipicoten 11.00 a.m. to Hawk Junction 12.35 p.m., connection with No. 2 for Sault Ste. Marie. Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.
